crossRefs.note: All the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over. The king also himself passed over the brook…
The king said to Ziba, “What do you mean by these?” Ziba said, “The donkeys are for the king’s household to ride on…
Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David…
Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, ‘Don’t lodge tonight at the fords of the wilderness, but by all…

translations.web: Behold, I will stay at the fords of the wilderness, until word comes from you to inform me.”
translations.bsb: See, I will wait at the fords of the wilderness until word comes from you to inform me.”
translations.kjv: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.
translations.asv: See, I will tarry at the fords of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.
